description: This file contains a PHP class implementing an admin controller for managing localisation languages within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, and saving language data, and defines the structure for handling HTTP requests and rendering views related to localisation languages.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing localisation languages in the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the list of languages with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list view of languages, primarily for AJAX requests or API responses.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares data for the language list, including sorting, filtering, and pagination calculations.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a language.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving of language data, handling create and update operations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected language entries after permission check and optional dependency validation.
